states.claim: profile is the EXIF StringInfo obtained from the image profile; if absent, the function returns without further object state.
exif points to the byte storage of the EXIF profile datum.
directory is initialized to an interior byte address within the exif storage region at the first IFD offset.
exif_resources is a newly created splay tree resource used to track visited directory entries.
states.evidence:
L576: exif_resources=NewSplayTree((int (*)(const void *,const void *)) NULL,
L577: (void *(*)(void *)) NULL,(void *(*)(void *)) NULL);

states.claim: When level > 0, directory is restored from the directory_stack entry at the decremented level, preserving its provenance into the exif storage region.
q is an interior byte address derived from directory plus the current entry offset.
When number_bytes <= 4, p is set to q+8, an interior byte address within the directory entry.
When number_bytes > 4, p is set to an interior byte address within the exif storage region at dir_offset.
value is initialized to NULL before format-specific allocation.
For BYTE/UNDEFINED format, value may be allocated as a new string buffer of number_bytes+1 bytes.
For STRING/default format, value may be allocated as a new string buffer of number_bytes+1 bytes.
When value is non-NULL, it is released with DestroyString after being used.
key is a newly allocated string copy of property.
key is released with DestroyString after use.
When following an EXIF/GPS/Interop offset, directory_stack entries are populated with directory pointers into the exif storage region and associated entry/offset state.
exif_resources is destroyed before the function returns.
